nonBlockingIssues.description: Redundant nullish coalescing: `verdict.issues ?? []` in subprocess-transport.ts:170 is unnecessary because EvaluatorVerdictSchema uses `.default([])`, guaranteeing issues is always an array after parsing.

Changed type annotation style from `const verdict: EvaluatorVerdict = ...` to `const verdict = ... as EvaluatorVerdict`. The `as` cast is slightly less safe than a type annotation. Both work correctly here but the original annotation style was preferable.
Deep nesting (~200 lines) in the `!transportError` else block in execution-loop.ts:634. An early-return/continue pattern would improve readability.
Misleading log message: when non-blocking issues are staged into `_pendingNonBlockingIssues`, the log says 'accumulated' but they're only truly accumulated into StageContext later (~line 886).

Potential double-prefix in UIApprovalHandler.requestIssueApproval: delegates to requestApproval which adds `Phase N:` prefix, but the description parameter already contains the phase prefix and issue details, potentially showing `Phase 1: Phase 1: ...` in the approval UI.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the behavioral contract change in the execution loop: evaluator transport failures (timeout, error) now trigger graceful degradation — the pipeline continues instead of failing. Previously, exhausting evaluator retries was a hard failure. This is intentional and workers should expect pipeline continuation on evaluator transport errors.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature issue-gating-execution-loop (commit 411c376) changed tests/evaluator-activation.test.ts from `expect(result.completed).toBe(false)` to `expect(result.completed).toBe(true)` for transport error scenarios. The change is documented in .factory/library/architecture.md but not in AGENTS.md.
